name: Globus Spirits Ltd
title: Globus Spirits Ltd - 533104 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Globus Q4 FY26: bulk EBITDA INR8.3/l and 80% utilisation, but Q4 volume dented by ENA inventory build; capacity now 334 MLPA with no fundraise needed, net debt INR627 cr.

utilisation.quote: For the year, we achieved a strong 80% capacity utilization, adjusting for the UP start -up period.

capex.quote: I foresee somewhere between INR60 crores to INR80 crores of capex sustaining for a few years.

triggers.label: Q4 ENA inventory build, liquidates Q1
triggers.quote: This friction resulted in a one-time inventory buildup at our facilities during Q4.

triggers.label: Bulk EBITDA INR6.3/l FY26 within INR5-7
triggers.quote: We achieved INR6.3 in Q4 and that's within that INR5 to INR7 range.

triggers.label: Fundraise put on hold
triggers.quote: the plan for capital raise -- equity capital raise has been put on hold.

triggers.label: Delhi R&O volumes stopped by policy
triggers.quote: As of the end of Q4, we decided until the policy is not stabilized, we will not operate in Delhi.

guidance.quote: INR5 to INR7 is our guidance for the EBITDA per liter.
So well over 20 crores will be the target for this year.
INR500 crores is what we have called out.
I think our target in this space is 16% to 18%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: FY26 was that range and FY27, we expect the same range.

red_flags.label: Q4 P&A EBITDA loss INR5 cr; Delhi R&O volumes halted
red_flags.quote: Overall, the segment generated an EBITDA level loss of INR5 crores in the quarter

red_flags.label: Fundraise enabling resolutions kept open
red_flags.quote: we are in no immediate pressure to dilute equity at this stage.

evasions.quote: We are not prepared to give you the numbers immediately on this call.

evasions.topic: UP monthly volumes and realisation per case
evasions.quote: We don't release it. We don't release it.
